meta_description: Outdoor sandstone floor tiles for patios, garden paths, porches and terraces: textured natural stone in sand tones. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These outdoor sandstone floor tiles are natural stone tiles for patios, garden paths, porches and terraces, supplied by Pak Clay in sand tones that suit Pakistani sun and garden settings.

## How they look
Sandstone has a textured, matt surface and warm colouring, with natural shade changes from piece to piece. Laid as paving, it gives an outdoor floor a calm, natural look that sits well next to lawns, brick and terracotta.

## Where they work
- **Patios and terraces** around a house or farmhouse.
- **Garden paths**, where it works as garden path tiles between planting.
- **Porches, courtyards and pool surrounds**: tell us the use so we can advise.

A textured stone surface tends to give better grip underfoot than a polished finish, which matters outdoors, and sandstone paving is a traditional choice for gardens and courtyards.

## Good to know
- Material: natural sandstone
- Use: outdoor floors
- Category: outdoor stone tiles
- Size, thickness and coverage per square foot: confirm on enquiry

Lay patio tiles on a drained, compacted base with a slight fall so water runs off, and order the full quantity together because each piece varies in shade. For driveways, confirm thickness and suitability with us first. Compare options in [outdoor floor tiles in Pakistan](/blog/outdoor-floor-tiles-in-pakistan-terracotta-otti-and-paver-options), and for slopes and steps see [ramp, stair and balcony tiles](/blog/ramp-garage-stair-and-balcony-tiles-safe-outdoor-options).

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour and surface, then send your area and city for a dated quote. For walls in the same stone, see the [exterior sandstone wall tiles](/products/exterior-natural-sand-stone-wall-tiles), or browse all [outdoor stone tiles](/categories/outdoor-wall-tiles-stone).

faqs.q: What is the price of outdoor sandstone floor tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the floor area, thickness, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.
Sandstone's textured surface tends to grip better than polished stone, but any outdoor floor can get slippery with algae or standing water. A slight fall for drainage and regular sweeping help.

faqs.q: Sandstone or terracotta for a patio?
faqs.a: Sandstone gives a pale, natural stone look; terracotta gives a warm red clay floor. Both work outdoors on a well-drained base, so choose by colour and the style of the house.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Outdoor Natural Sand Stone" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
